comment: Hand-maintained cross-check for registry_guard.py. Every source in sources.json must have an entry here with status='green' AND be independently re-verified against doc/submission_registry.md at run time (registry_guard.assert_green does both). Update this file only after checking doc/submission_registry.md yourself -- do not copy an entry forward without re-reading the registry, since statuses can change (see the 2026-07-20 successor-row/overlap-patch ruling that flipped many prior 'valid' submissions to red).

exp038_sigmafixed.registry_note: context_rows: 1. sigma_mode=fixed. Current green champion, LB 0.6866381028699935 (2026-07-21).

exp040_metric.registry_note: context_rows: 1. metric_weight=0.6 tile-RMSE-shaped loss. Standalone green model, weaker solo (0.6955180267195701) but earmarked for Track G3 blend diversity.

exp056.registry_note: context_rows: 1. mean-intensity x normalized-shape factorization (factorized_mean_shape), from-scratch CompactUNet backbone. Solo LB 0.6839627937847801 (2026-07-24), submission_gate.py GO.

exp064_effb3.registry_note: context_rows: 1. pretrained_factorized architecture, timm efficientnet_b3 encoder (ImageNet, Apache-2.0). NEW green champion, solo LB 0.6720097338314985 (2026-07-30).

exp064_effv2s.registry_note: context_rows: 1. pretrained_factorized architecture, timm tf_efficientnetv2_s encoder (ImageNet, Apache-2.0). Solo LB 0.6740019855472996 (2026-07-30), 2nd best.

exp064_swin_lr2e4.registry_note: context_rows: 1. pretrained_factorized architecture, timm swin_tiny_patch4_window7_224 encoder (ImageNet, MIT), lr=2e-4 (lr=1e-3 arm NaN-diverged, not used). fold0/4 gate-passed (best gate result since exp056); 5-fold trained 2026-07-29, not yet submitted to LB.

exp064_pvt_v2_b0_lr2e4.registry_note: context_rows: 1. pretrained_factorized architecture, timm pvt_v2_b0 encoder (ImageNet, Apache-2.0). New backbone family (Pyramid Vision Transformer v2), architecturally distinct from EfficientNet/ConvNeXt/Swin. Solo LB 0.672541575619076 (2026-08-01), effective tie with exp064_effb3.

exp064_swin_small_lr2e4.registry_note: context_rows: 1. pretrained_factorized architecture, timm swin_small_patch4_window7_224 encoder (ImageNet, MIT), lr=2e-4. Capacity scale-up of exp064_swin_lr2e4. Solo LB 0.6719466133572829 (2026-08-01), worse than swin_lr2e4 by +0.00151.

exp064_convnext_lr2e4.registry_note: context_rows: 1. pretrained_factorized architecture, timm convnext_tiny encoder (ImageNet, MIT), lr=2e-4. Solo LB 0.6837550386507026 (2026-08-02), worst of the exp064 family.

exp064_effb1.registry_note: context_rows: 1. pretrained_factorized architecture, timm efficientnet_b1 encoder (ImageNet, Apache-2.0). 5-fold OOF 0.59934, no solo LB yet.

exp064_effb2.registry_note: context_rows: 1. pretrained_factorized architecture, timm efficientnet_b2 encoder (ImageNet, Apache-2.0). 5-fold OOF 0.59693, beats effb3's own OOF. No solo LB yet.

exp064_regnety016.registry_note: context_rows: 1. pretrained_factorized architecture, timm regnety_016 encoder (ImageNet, Apache-2.0). 5-fold OOF 0.60025, no solo LB yet.

exp064_densenet121.registry_note: context_rows: 1. pretrained_factorized architecture, timm densenet121 encoder (ImageNet, Apache-2.0). 5-fold OOF 0.59990, no solo LB yet.
